properties.description: Daily pipeline — BIMIO 267 12 Hour Prevented report. Migrated from Toad Automation Script BC_BIMIO_267_Daily.

activities.name: Lookup_ODS_Refresh_Check
activities.description: Check if today's ODS data load has completed. POC: uses Azure SQL. Production: switch dataset to DS_Oracle_ODS_Log and source type to OracleSource.

source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM MAXRPD.T_ODS_LOG WHERE CAST(ems AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)

activities.name: SetVar_ReportDate
activities.description: Set yesterday's date as the report date. Replicates: Set_Variable_1 (VariableActivity).

activities.name: Lookup_Ops_Email_List
activities.description: Fetch TO email list for Operations teams from config table.

source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT STRING_AGG(re.email_address, ';') AS email_list FROM config.report_email re JOIN config.report r ON re.report_id = r.report_id WHERE r.report_name = 'BC_BIMIO_267_Daily' AND re.recipient_group = 'OPERATIONS' AND re.email_type = 'TO' AND re.is_active = 'Y' AND r.is_active = 'Y'

activities.name: Lookup_BI_Email_List
activities.description: Fetch BCC email list for BI team from config table.

source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT STRING_AGG(re.email_address, ';') AS email_list FROM config.report_email re JOIN config.report r ON re.report_id = r.report_id WHERE r.report_name = 'BC_BIMIO_267_Daily' AND re.recipient_group = 'BI_TEAM' AND re.email_type = 'BCC' AND re.is_active = 'Y' AND r.is_active = 'Y'

activities.name: Lookup_Alert_Email_List
activities.description: Fetch CC email list for alert-only recipients from config table.

source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT STRING_AGG(re.email_address, ';') AS email_list FROM config.report_email re JOIN config.report r ON re.report_id = r.report_id WHERE r.report_name = 'BC_BIMIO_267_Daily' AND re.recipient_group = 'ALERT_ONLY' AND re.email_type = 'CC' AND re.is_active = 'Y' AND r.is_active = 'Y'

activities.name: If_ODS_Refreshed
activities.description: Branch on ODS refresh status. Replicates: If_1 (VariableIfElseActivity).

ifFalseActivities.name: Email_ODS_Not_Refreshed
ifFalseActivities.description: Send alert email when ODS data is not ready. Replicates: Email_2 (SendEmailActivity).

body.value: @concat('{"subject":"BIMIO 267 - 12 Hour Prevented Daily (MTD, YTD) For_', variables('report_date'), '","to":"', activity('Lookup_Ops_Email_List').output.firstRow.email_list, '","cc":"', activity('Lookup_Alert_Email_List').output.firstRow.email_list, '","body":"ODS data has not been refreshed today. The daily report cannot be generated."}')

ifTrueActivities.name: Copy_ReportData_To_Blob
ifTrueActivities.description: Run main report SQL and export results to Blob Storage as CSV. Replicates: File_1 (SelectToExcelActivity). Note: ADF exports CSV; downstream Azure Function converts to Excel.

sqlReaderQuery.value:
SELECT
    sub.[Network],
    sub.[LDZ],
    sub.[Depot],
    sub.[Work Order],
    sub.[Root Work Order],
    sub.[Emergency Date],
    sub.[Gas Prevented],
    sub.[Time Difference],
    sub.[Address],
    CASE WHEN sub.[Gas Prevented] > DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(DATEADD(DAY,-1,GETDATE())), MONTH(DATEADD(DAY,-1,GETDATE())), 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS [MTD],
    CASE WHEN sub.[Time Difference] <= 12 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS [Less 12],
    CASE WHEN sub.[Time Difference] > 12  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS [Great 12],
    1 AS [Count]
FROM (
    SELECT
        dorg.network                                                            AS [Network],
        dorg.ldz                                                                AS [LDZ],
        CASE WHEN dorg.depot_work_group = 'DEPOT_K' THEN 'DEPOT_L'
             ELSE dorg.depot_work_group END                                     AS [Depot],
        prev_dwor.work_order_number                                             AS [Work Order],
        dwor.work_order_number                                                  AS [Root Work Order],
        dwor.reported_date_time                                                 AS [Emergency Date],
        DATEADD(SECOND,
            DATEDIFF(SECOND, '00:00:00', CAST(RIGHT(dtim.hour_24_minute,8) AS TIME)),
            CAST(CONVERT(DATE, dcal.date_disp_1, 103) AS DATETIME2)
        )                                                                       AS [Gas Prevented],
        ROUND(
            CAST(DATEDIFF(MINUTE,
                dwor.reported_date_time,
                DATEADD(SECOND,
                    DATEDIFF(SECOND,'00:00:00', CAST(RIGHT(dtim.hour_24_minute,8) AS TIME)),
                    CAST(CONVERT(DATE, dcal.date_disp_1, 103) AS DATETIME2)
                )
            ) AS FLOAT) / 60, 2
        )                                                                       AS [Time Difference],
        dadr.display_address                                                    AS [Address]
    FROM abcbimart.fct_gas_escapes_v ge
        JOIN abcbimart.dim_work_orders     dwor      ON ge.dwor_id_root               = dwor.id
        JOIN abcbimart.dim_work_orders     prev_dwor ON ge.dwor_id_gas_prevented      = prev_dwor.id
        JOIN abcbimart.dim_organisation    dorg      ON ge.dorg_id_root               = dorg.id
        JOIN abcbimart.dim_addresses       dadr      ON ge.dadr_id_root               = dadr.id
        JOIN abcbimart.dim_calendar        dcal      ON ge.dcal_id_gas_prevented_date = dcal.id
        JOIN abcbimart.dim_time            dtim      ON ge.dtim_id_gas_prevented_time = dtim.id
    WHERE ge.latest = 'Y'
      AND dcal.date_oracle >= DATEADD(MONTH, 3,
                                  DATEFROMPARTS(
                                      YEAR(DATEADD(MONTH, -3, DATEADD(DAY, -4, GETDATE()))),
                                  1, 1))
      AND dcal.date_oracle < CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
) sub
